prayers.title: Trisagion Prayer
prayers.text:
Holy God, Holy Mighty, Holy Immortal, have mercy on us. (Three times)

Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and ever and unto ages of ages. Amen.

prayers.title: The Jesus Prayer
prayers.text: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God, have mercy on me, a sinner.

prayers.title: The Lord’s Prayer
prayers.text: Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. Lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil.

prayers.title: Morning Prayer
prayers.text: O Lord, grant that I may meet all that this day brings with spiritual peace. Teach me to receive Your will with humility, to speak with kindness, to work honestly, and to remember Your presence in every person I meet. Guard my mind from distraction, my heart from resentment, and my actions from harm. Amen.

prayers.title: Evening Prayer
prayers.text: O Lord, I thank You for the mercies of this day. Forgive the sins I committed knowingly or unknowingly, in thought, word, or deed. Heal what I have damaged, bless those I have failed, receive those who suffer, and grant peaceful rest. Amen.

prayers.title: Before Meals
prayers.text: Christ our God, bless the food and drink of Your servants, for You are holy, always, now and ever and unto ages of ages. Amen.

prayers.title: After Meals
prayers.text: We thank You, Christ our God, for satisfying us with Your earthly gifts. Do not deprive us of Your heavenly Kingdom, but remain with us in peace and save us. Amen.

prayers.title: For the Sick
prayers.text: O Lord, Physician of souls and bodies, visit Your servant in mercy. Grant strength, wise care, patience, and healing according to Your will. Comfort all who keep watch, and guide those who provide treatment. Amen.

prayers.title: For the Departed
prayers.text: O God of spirits and of all flesh, give rest to Your departed servants in a place of light, peace, and refreshment. Forgive every sin committed in human weakness, for You are good and love mankind. Amen.

prayers.title: Before Travel
prayers.text: O Lord, guide and protect all who travel. Keep us attentive, patient, and free from danger. Bless those we leave and those we go to meet, and bring us safely to our destination. Amen.

prayers.title: Before Work or Study
prayers.text: O Lord, open my mind to what is true, steady my hands in useful work, and keep me from pride, carelessness, and discouragement. Let what I do serve my neighbor and glorify You. Amen.

prayers.title: In Fear or Anxiety
prayers.text: Lord Jesus Christ, remain with me in this fear. Quiet what is disordered, strengthen what is weak, and show me the next faithful step. I place what I cannot control into Your mercy. Amen.

prayers.title: For Forgiveness
prayers.text: O merciful Lord, reveal my sins without driving me to despair. Give me courage to confess the truth, repair what I can, forgive those who have wounded me, and begin again in humility. Amen.

prayers.title: For Peace
prayers.text: O King of Peace, restrain hatred, protect the innocent, comfort the displaced, enlighten rulers, and turn every heart away from vengeance. Give courage to peacemakers and repentance to those who profit from suffering. Amen.
